text:
celia: Noticing a small but sharp jump in resume churn after the console rollout that enabled 'route_preference=fast-path' AND rotated the resume token TTL. Clients are reconnecting and issuing two resume requests back-to-back. A few tenants reported unexpected invoice line-items.

omar: Can you paste a minimal log clip? Is token rotation happening on resume?

celia: Snip from ws-proxy:
```
2026-10-01T09:22:01Z INFO auth_resume session=sess-413 token=tok-old route=eu-main
2026-10-01T09:22:01Z WARN resume_no_ack session=sess-413
2026-10-01T09:22:01Z INFO token_rotate session=sess-413 old=tok-old new=tok-new
2026-10-01T09:22:01Z INFO auth_resume session=sess-413 token=tok-new route=eu-fast
```
So the console toggled route preference and shortened token rotation window at the same time; clients re-auth with a fresh token before the runtime acked the first resume. Billing pipeline treats any auth_resume as billable.

phil: Two immediate mitigations: 1) server-side dedupe: if same session but token changed within 2s, delay billing until runtime ack; 2) revert token-rotation TTL change for canary cohort. Which is quicker?

ruth: Dedupe guard is small in session-manager: classify resume events into "speculative" if no ack yet and suppress billing emission until ack arrives or 5s elapses. I'll prototype.

omar: Telemetry visibility was poor: resume metrics dropped the session_id and token_ttl tags because the metric-forwarder refused unknown labels during the console push. We couldn't easily find affected tenants.

metrics-bot: Created alert: resume_dups/session > 3 in 2m -> page eng-oncall.

celia: Short plan: ruth ships speculative-resume guard to staging; I revert TTL change for canary; phil patches billing to require runtime ack before charge. Also hotfix metric-forwarder to passthrough unknown labels for a short window.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan: ruth/patch/spec-resume -> staging 09:50 UTC; phil/patch/billing-ack -> staging 10:00 UTC; celia/rollback/token-ttl -> canary 10:05 UTC; metrics-bot/patch/label-pass -> staging 09:55 UTC.

phil: Long-term: console rollout checklist must flag simultaneous route-affecting and auth-affecting toggles. Also add a dashboard panel: resume_attempts vs runtime_resume_ack lag by token_ttl and route.

ruth: I'll add unit + e2e tests to assert billing only after runtime_ack. Also emit a temporary metric `resume_speculative_suppressed` so we can backfill.

celia: Thanks all. Priority order: spec-resume guard + metric passthrough, then billing guard. If retries don't drop after those, we rollback the route flip.
